name: weatheo-climate-lu
title: Luxembourg municipal climate normals 1991-2020 and climate shift since 1961-1990 (ERA5-Land)
description: Climate normals 1991-2020 and their shift since 1961-1990 for 100 municipalities of Luxembourg (commune code), from Copernicus ERA5-Land monthly means (0.1 deg) with ERA5 single-level monthly means (0.25 deg) where ERA5-Land has no cell. Each municipality takes the nearest grid cell to its reference point. Temperatures are moved from the grid cell's model elevation (grid_elevation_m) to the elevation of the municipality's reference point (elevation_m, Copernicus DEM GLO-90) with a fixed lapse rate of 6.5 degC per km: t = t_cell + 0.0065 * (grid_elevation_m - elevation_m). Precipitation is not adjusted. The 1961-1990 to 1991-2020 temperature shift does not depend on this adjustment. Area covered: Luxembourg (N 50.3, W 5.6, S 49.3, E 6.6). Values are reanalysis grid-cell values adjusted for altitude, not station observations: they can differ from official station normals, mostly near coasts, in cities and in steep terrain. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2026. Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use that may be made of the Copernicus information or data it contains.
